sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 34 points from 16 games, travel to New Mills on Saturday 14 November for an Edward Case Cup fixture (15:00 KO). The leaders are in strong form, having won their most recent league match and won three of their last five league outings. New Mills sit 10th in the table on 21 points and have had a mixed recent run, so Sandbach will be favourites, though cup competition can always produce surprises.
divisionWide: The division's title race remains competitive, with second-placed Eccleshall (31 points, 14 games) facing a home fixture against Sandbach on Saturday, while third-placed Wolverhampton Casuals (31 points, 13 games) host New Mills on Wednesday in excellent form with five consecutive league wins. AFC Bridgnorth, fourth on 30 points, travel to Widnes on Tuesday in what looks a favourable fixture given Widnes's poor form at the bottom. In-form Bilston Town (6th, 27 points) play twice this week—hosting Alsager on Wednesday and Eccleshall on Saturday—and will be looking to climb further after five consecutive league wins. Mid-table Allscott Heath host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, while Brereton Social entertain Crewe, Foley Meir face Market Drayton Town away, and Telford Town travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads; Wednesfield Community host Widnes in a bottom-half clash. Widnes (19th, 7 points) face two difficult assignments after a winless recent run, while Alsager Town (18th, 8 points) and Telford Town (20th, 7 points) continue to struggle near the foot of the table.
